newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bangchak details capital increase spending.
newsitem.headline: Bangchak details capital increase spending.

text.p: Bangchak Petroleum Plc spent 3.061 billion baht ($98.7 million) from a capital increase in June 1994 on setting up petrol stations and improving its oil refining capability, the firm said in a statement on Wednesday.
It said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that it had so far spent 2.866 billion baht on setting up petrol stations alone.
The company said that during the first half of 1997 it had installed units to separate sulphur from diesel oil as part of attempts to improve oil quality and the environment.
Construction was still under way and the company had invested 195 million baht on the project so far.
The company offered 104.4 million new shares in June 1994.
